name: Tempest
author: E. T. Carter
description: Two ranks of towering storm clouds recede over a dark sea toward a vanishing point in the right third, each lit from inside by slow lights that climb and sink through its lobes and anvil. Pleated curtains of slanted rain hang beneath them and the sea mirrors their glowing bases as the eye drifts forward.

params.label: Inner glow
params.effect: How strongly the slow lights burn inside the cloud towers.

params.label: Rain
params.effect: Density and pleated gather of the rain curtains under each tower.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed of the drift forward along the squall line and of the lights moving through the clouds.
